audience: developers and ops teams who watch cron jobs and scheduled tasks with Cronitor

useCases.title: Find which monitors are failing right now
useCases.text: The AI lists your monitors with their passing or failing status and summarizes the failing ones, so you see what needs attention first.

useCases.title: Check if one job is healthy
useCases.text: The AI opens a monitor and reads its latest event, latest invocations and passing status, then tells you in plain words if the job is healthy.

useCases.title: Pause a monitor or change its schedule
useCases.text: The AI updates a monitor by key, for example to pause it with paused:true or to change the schedule. It sends only the fields you give.

useCases.title: Create a new monitor for a scheduled job
useCases.text: The AI creates a monitor in Cronitor with the fields you provide, so a new job is watched from its first run.

useCases.title: Send a run, complete or fail ping for a monitor
useCases.text: The AI reports a telemetry event (run, complete, fail, ok or pause) for a monitor. This records job activity and can clear or trigger alerts.
